Python Automation in Azure Cloud & web scraping

Prem Kumar K Mobile : +91 9677944561 Email

: premkumarangceb@gmail.com

Linkedin url : www.linkedin.com/in/prem-kumar-5551ab289

OBJECTIVE

To leverage my specialized expertise in Azure ETL Automation and Python development with web

scraping to drive innovative technological solutions and contribute to cutting-edge data-driven projects.

PROFILE SUMMARY

Highly skilled Python Developer with 5.4 years of comprehensive IT experience, specializing in

advanced Python Django web development and web scraping techniques.

Designed and implemented end-to-end data pipelines, utilizing Azure Data Factory, to transform raw data

into actionable insights.

Employed Azure Databricks and PySpark for advanced data processing and analytics, ensuring optimal

performance and scalability.

Spearheaded the development and implementation of storage solutions, utilizing Azure Data Lake Gen2,

and Azure SQL. These efforts resulted in a 50% reduction in data retrieval time and improved overall

system performance.

Expert in designing and implementing robust web scraping solutions using cutting-edge Python

libraries including BeautifulSoup, Requests, and Selenium WebDriver.

Developed models for product tracking, user management, and vendor integration using Django

ORM.

Created a unique product ID generation system for users purchasing directly from companies,

enabling seamless tracking of product services and insurance.

Django ORM: Used for efficient database interactions, complex queries, and relationships

between models (e.g., Product, User, Vendor, Insurance).

Django REST Framework (DRF): Built RESTful APIs for vendor integration and external

system communication.

 Proficient in extracting, transforming, and analyzing data from diverse web sources, creating

sophisticated data collection and processing frameworks.

Advanced skills in Python ecosystem including Django, data manipulation with Pandas, and

integration with various databases and APIs.

Experienced in end-to-end project development, from requirements gathering to deployment, with

a strong focus on creating efficient, maintainable Python solutions.

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATION

BE ECE

81 % , Government College of Engg , krishnagiri in 2007-2011

HSC with 89 % , Bishop Ubagraswamy higher Secondary School in 2005- 2007

10 th with 92 % , Govt higher Secondary School in 2002-2004

TECHINICAL SKILLS

Cloud & Deployment

: Azure ADF, DataBricks, ADLS, AWS EC2, AWS S3, Docker

Programming Languages : Python, JavaScript (backend integration with basics), HTML, CSS

Data Processing & Analysis : DataBricks, PySpark, Pandas,

Web Frameworks

: Django, Django REST Framework

Scraping Tools

: Selenium, Beautiful soup, Requests

Databases

: Azure SQl, Django ORM, MySQL

Development Tools / IDEs

: VS Code, IDLE

Tracking Tools containerization Tool

: Zoho sprint : Docker

Testing Frameworks

: Unit test,

Version control

: Git, Git Hub

Development Methodologies: MVT architecture, Agile Process

API Testing

: Postman

EXPERIENCE

Shravas Technologies IT India Pvt Ltd.

Software Developer 08 th May 2025 to present

Mahendra Next Wealth IT India Private Limited, Salem

Python Developer 10 th November 2023 to 7th May 2025

ADM Developers, Coimbatore

Programmer Analyst 12th Aug 2019 to 28 th October 2023

PROJECTS

Project 1 – ADM Developers, Coimbatore

Project Name : Reg Insurance Product (Product Management and Tracking System)

Technologies : Python, Django, DRF,, MySQL, AWS (S3, EC2)

Backend Development

Designed and implemented a comprehensive Insurance product management system using Django and

Django REST Framework

Developed complex data models to track product lifecycle including insurance, warranty, and Annual

Maintenance Contracts (AMC)

Created sophisticated user authentication and role-based access control systems for different

stakeholders (users, vendors, and companies)



Implemented automated calculation systems for product resale values based on service history and

condition

Built notification systems using Django signals and Celery for time-sensitive warranty expiration

Project 2 - Mahendra Next Wealth IT India Pvt Ltd, Salem

Project Name

: Web Scraping & Data Automaion in Azure & API Development

Technologies

: Python, Azure Data Factory, DataBricks, Django, Selenium,

Tools used

: VS code, Git, IIS server, MySQL, Postman,

Web Scraping and Data Automation

Designed and implemented end-to-end data pipelines, utilizing Azure Data Factory, to transform raw data

into actionable insights.

Employed Azure Databricks and PySpark for advanced data processing and analytics, ensuring optimal

performance and scalability.

Spearheaded the development and implementation of storage solutions, utilizing Azure Data Lake

Gen2, and Azure SQL. These efforts resulted in a 50% reduction in data retrieval time and improved

overall system performance.

 Designed and implemented sophisticated web scraping solutions using advanced Python libraries

including BeautifulSoup, Requests, and Selenium WebDriver.

Developed robust data extraction frameworks capable of scraping complex websites with multiple

layers of pagination and dynamic content.

Created custom scraping scripts to extract structured data from diverse sources, including Startup

company websites, financial websites and Insurance company websites.



Implemented intelligent scraping techniques to handle:

Dynamic content loaded via JavaScript

Websites with complex authentication mechanisms

Anti-scraping protection and rate limiting

Developed proxy rotation and user-agent switching mechanisms to ensure consistent and

uninterrupted data collection.

Project 3 – Shravas Technologies IT India Pvt Ltd, Bangalore

Python Development and Data Processing in Azure Cloud

Designed and implemented efficient data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, and Databricks to transform raw data from source to mart layers, resulting in a 40% reduction in processing time and improved decision- making.

Spearheaded the development and implementation of storage solutions, utilizing Azure Data Lake Gen2, and Azure SQL. These efforts resulted in a 50% reduction in data retrieval time and improved overall system performance.

Built end-to-end Python applications with focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.

Developed data processing pipelines to transform raw scraped data into clean, structured formats

using Pandas and NumPy.

Created automated workflows for:

Data cleaning and preprocessing

Advanced data transformation

Statistical analysis and visualization



Implemented efficient data storage solutions using:

SQL databases (MySQL, SQLite)

Excel file and JSON file formats

 Developed RESTful APIs using Django Rest framework to expose scraped and processed data.

DECLARATION

I here by confirmed that the given above details are true to the best of my knowledge.

Date:
